content: Sia s3d background upload pipeline (first-party README): all objects first buffered to a local uploads directory (durable staging is part of the durability path); a background loop bin-packs small objects and uploads a group when packing waste < threshold (10%) or any object is older than sia.uploadDeadline (24h); sia.uploadThreads (default 4) bounds concurrent group uploads; sia.diskUsageLimit (default 10 GiB) bounds staging disk = backpressure; s3d flush forces immediate upload of all pending objects; s3d status + admin Prometheus endpoint expose pipeline metrics; snapshot creation blocks flushing buffered objects first (graceful drain) and objects still buffered at snapshot time are listed-but-unreadable (accepted-vs-durable gap). Shutdown/restore semantics: pending uploads consume local disk; SQLite metadata must be recoverable; disk-full/low-balance inhibit eviction.
